init.title: Tune detection parameters
init.description:
These values were calibrated from real data. Only change them if you're seeing false positives or missed detections.

**Open threshold** — score needed to trigger open. Higher = fewer false positives but slower detection.
**Close threshold** — score needed to trigger close. Higher = less likely to drop out mid-open.
**Open decay** — how fast open evidence fades each minute (lower = faster fade).
**Close decay** — how fast close evidence fades each minute.
**Equilibrium delta** — when open, suppress close evidence if |room − outdoor| is below this (°C). Handles the case where the room equilibrates near outdoor temperature.
**Equilibrium suppress** — how many close evidence points to remove per tick when equilibrated.
